descriptionProgressScope: Compares completed work with the active scope (TASK/BUG without N/A), by items and points. External dependencies are excluded.
descriptionWip: Breaks down work in progress (in progress and blocked) by items and points.
descriptionBlocked: Shows how many items are blocked and which have accumulated the most days.
descriptionOverdue: Compares overdue items and points with the remaining scope.
descriptionBurnup: Shows how scope and completed items changed over time.
descriptionAging: Lists the oldest WIP items since their current episode began.
descriptionTeamLoad: Distributes in-progress work by team owner. Blocked items and items with an external owner are not part of the load.
descriptionHours: Sums hours entered in manual logs, grouped by author.
descriptionTokens: AI token usage recorded in the project by status, type and dimensions, plus the daily evolution; the series starts at the token coverage start date.
